text: Let's remember! Every digit lives in a house, and the house gives its value.
Compare from the left. When rounding, five or more goes up.
To add and subtract, start with the ones: carry one, borrow ten, and check by adding.
Your project: open a pretend shop, add the prices and give change. For more practice, visit AMBKidsJoy, and don't forget to subscribe. Goodbye!
